problem: If 2x+y=20, what is the value of 8x^2+18x+8xy+9y+2y^2?
notes: Paraphrase of Bedrock Prep hard Problem 23, One Variable in Disguise. Recognize the expression as 2(2x+y)^2+9(2x+y). Substituting 20 yields 2*400+9*20=980. A calculator route can verify the identity at multiple values, but must explain why the expression depends only on 2x+y. Category index: https://www.bedrockprep.com/problems
